extracted.intended_audience: patent analysts, IP policymakers, WIPO researchers, patent office staff, and IP statisticians
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction/interpretation of WIPO statistical metrics for patents, utility models and trademarks (office-level and origin-level counts, procedural timings and examiner resources) used for cross‑country comparison and monitoring. Includes data definitions and caveats given in the WIPO tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total (patent applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of patent applications (by office and/or by origin) for the reporting year (e.g., 'Total (a)' in Table A60).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the headline count for an office or origin. Note (a): Applications by origin data are incomplete because some offices do not report by origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resident patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent applications filed by applicants resident in the office's jurisdiction (resident applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported alongside total and non-resident counts to show domestic filing activity and share of resident filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-resident patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent applications filed at the office by applicants resident outside the office's jurisdiction (non-resident applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for measuring international demand on an office; reported with resident totals to disaggregate origin of filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent applications by origin
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications attributed to a country/region of origin (applicants' residence) rather than the office where filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides origin-based statistics complementing office counts. Caveat: origin data are incomplete for some offices (note (a)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Change over previous year (applications/grants/in force)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported change (positive or negative) in the relevant metric compared with the previous year (e.g., '+228', '–246').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows year‑on‑year dynamics. WIPO reports absolute changes in the tables; interpret alongside base counts for context.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT national phase entry
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of national phase entries under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) entering a particular office in the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of internationalisation of PCT filings into national/regional phases; reported separately from direct national filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants by office (patent grants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent grants issued by the office in the reporting year (often shown as Total, Resident, Non-resident).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures output of examined/granted patents by office; compare with applications to assess grant rates and throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent grants by origin
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patents granted in a reporting year attributed to the applicants' origin (country/region).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complements grants-by-office; WIPO notes grants-by-origin data may be incomplete because some offices do not report by origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents in force (in force by office)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of patents maintained (in force) at the office at the reporting date (with change over previous year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of the active patent stock burden on an office/jurisdiction and of longer-term patenting trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total applications processed (procedural)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of patent applications processed by the office in the reporting year (see Table A62 'Total applications processed').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be used to measure workload; broken down into outcome categories (granted/rejected/withdrawn/abandoned).

rubrics_metrics.name: Granted (procedural)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of processed applications that resulted in a grant (decision outcome) in the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used with processed totals and timing metrics to evaluate an office's examination output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejected (procedural)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of processed applications that were rejected (decision outcome) in the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO cautions that 'rejection' definitions vary across offices (e.g., Canada does not record rejection as a final decision); interpret in light of national procedural definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawn or abandoned (procedural)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of applications that were withdrawn by applicants or abandoned during processing in the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures attrition outside formal rejection/grant decisions; important for accurate workload assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of examiners (FTE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full-time equivalent (FTE) number of patent examiners employed by the office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource indicator used to normalise office workload and throughput; reported as an FTE count to allow cross-office comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: First office action (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Median/average time (months) to the first office action from filing (reported in 'First office action (months)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures initial examination timeliness. Units are months; differences in practice/definition across offices can affect comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final office decision (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time (months) to a final office decision (grant, rejection or other final disposition) from filing (reported in 'Final office decision (months)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of overall examination duration. Interpret with notes on procedural differences and whether withdrawn/abandoned are counted as final decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural data harmonization caveats
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative caution that 'Every effort has been made to compile procedural data based on common definitions and concepts, but procedural differences make it extremely difficult to fully harmonize such data.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Canada and Australia treat 'rejection' differently. Users must apply caution when comparing procedural metrics across offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility model applications (total/resident/non-resident)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility model applications by office and by origin, disaggregated into Total, Resident and Non-resident (Table A63).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Utility models are reported separately from patents; used to measure activity in utility model systems. Origin data may be incomplete for some offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility model grants (total/resident/non-resident)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility model grants by office and by origin (Total, Resident, Non-resident).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parallel to patent grants but for utility models; useful to evaluate output of utility model systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications by office (table field)
rubrics_metrics.description: Column/field label indicating counts of applications filed at a given office (used across patent/utility model tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between counts by filing office and counts by origin; necessary for interpreting whether a figure is place-of-filing or applicant-origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications by origin data completeness note
rubrics_metrics.description: Footnote indicating that 'Applications by origin data are incomplete, because some offices do not report by origin.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A data-quality caveat affecting origin-based comparisons; users should account for missing origin reporting in some offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation conventions (.. and n.a.)
rubrics_metrics.description: '.. indicates not available. n.a. indicates not applicable.' appearing in tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains symbols used in tables; necessary when parsing table values programmatically or manually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark applications (total worldwide)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated global count of trademark applications filed in the reporting year (headline: 'Global trademark applications experienced a slight uptick in 2024, ... an estimated 11.7 million applications').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Headline statistic for trademarks; WIPO provides narrative context (year‑on‑year change and comparison to pre‑pandemic levels).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark application class count
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of goods and services classes specified in trademark applications (the 'application class count').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to harmonize filing-system differences (class-based comparisons). WIPO notes the class count declined marginally in 2024 and has larger year‑on‑year volatility than application counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark application time series (application year trends)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series counts of trademark applications and class counts by application year (figures covering 2010–2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables trend analysis across years (surges in 2020, declines in 2022–2024). Use the class-count harmonization where filing systems differ.

rubrics_metrics.name: International depositary authority (microorganisms)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of accepted international depositary authorities (e.g., ATCC, CGMCC, CCTCC, DSMZ, etc.) referenced in the tables/notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant for patents involving deposited biological material; these authorities are the recognised repositories for deposited strains referenced in patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Totals and aggregated estimates (e.g., 'Total (2024 estimates)')
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregated global estimates reported as totals for the reporting year (e.g., 'Total (2024 estimates) 3,725,000' for some aggregated metric).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregates across offices and instruments; users should consult footnotes about estimation methods and coverage for global totals.
